Features

Everything a notebook
should already do.

01

Capture anywhere

Talk, type, photo or file. Widgets, the share sheet and a web clipper mean the thought never has to wait for the right app.

02

Filing that learns

Burble creates the page, adds the task or books the event, then shows you what it did. Correct it once and it remembers your house rules.

03

Real ink

A low-latency pen, highlighter, lasso and shapes on lined, grid or blank paper. Handwriting is searchable and converts to text.

04

Notes that play back

Record while you write. Tap a stroke later and the recording plays from that moment.

05

Blocks and databases

A slash menu, tables, boards and calendars, templates, backlinks and a daily page that sums itself up each evening.

06

Open files, your cloud

Notes are plain files in Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox, readable by other note apps. Leave whenever you like and take everything.
